# TopUniversities

> > TopUniversities is a comprehensive platform connecting international students with leading universities, scholarships, and study abroad opportunities across the globe.

TopUniversities provides resources for postgraduate education, including master's fairs, scholarship opportunities, visa guidance, and university networking events. The platform serves international students seeking to study in top destinations including the UK, USA, Europe, Canada, and Australia.

## Key Topics

- Master's programs
- International scholarships
- Study abroad
- University applications
- QS rankings
- Post-study work permits
- Graduate visas
- STEM education
- Student support
- University networking
- Postgraduate education
- Admissions counseling
- Shanghai events
- Beijing events
- Work-study balance

## Master's Fairs & Events

- [Shanghai's top master's fair | 11 April TopUniversities](https://cn.topuniversities.com/events/masters/shanghai): Master's fair in Shanghai on April 11 with top universities, scholarships
- [Beijing's top master's fair | 12 April | TopUniversities](https://cn.topuniversities.com/events/masters/beijing): Master's fair in Beijing on April 12 with top universities, scholarships

- [QS Student Apply Support](https://qs.topuniversities.com/qs-student-apply-support?__hstc=220794823.50d75c2d192a1adaa45102fdbc2d6c76.1686752203924.1686752203924.1686752203924.1&__hssc=220794823.1.1686752203925&__hsfp=2267535624): QS student support for university applications, visas, and study abroad
